run_cmake_writer: run cmake_writer.py with an output directory to serialize all Faiss index types using cmake-built Faiss
test_index_serialization: test serialization of all Faiss index types by running cmake_writer.py and writing index files to a directory
generate_test_vectors: generate shared database vectors and binary vectors for Faiss index I/O backward compatibility testing
write_binary_indexes: write binary index types like BIVF, BFlat, and BHNSW to test binary serialization backward compatibility
verify_cmake_conda_compatibility: verify that cmake-built Faiss index files can be read by conda-built Faiss for backward compatibility
